title: Specialist Clinical Pharmacist - Intensive Care
company: Greater Ardwick University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
Band 7 Specialist Clinical Pharmacist - Intensive Care

We are looking for an enthusiastic pharmacist to join our critical care pharmacy team covering the 32-bed adult intensive care unit at Medlock Royal Infirmary. You will provide a daily clinical pharmacy service to the unit, attend consultant ward rounds, review complex drug regimens (antimicrobials, sedation, vasoactive agents, renal dose adjustment on CRRT) and contribute to unit guidelines.

Essential:
- MPharm degree and registration with the General Pharmaceutical Council (GPhC)
- Postgraduate Diploma in Clinical Pharmacy (or equivalent experience)
- Experience as a Band 6 rotational hospital pharmacist
- Independent prescriber or willingness to complete the qualification within 18 months

You will take part in the weekend, bank holiday and on-call rota and support the education of pharmacy technicians and foundation pharmacists.

title: Critical Care Staff Nurse - Band 6
company: Peel Green Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
Our 28-bed adult critical care unit in Salford is recruiting Band 6 Staff Nurses to join an experienced and friendly team. The unit admits level 2 and level 3 patients from general surgery, medicine, renal and the emergency department.

As a Band 6 you will take charge of the unit in the absence of the nurse in charge, supervise and assess junior staff and students, and deliver high-quality care to critically ill patients, including ventilated patients and those receiving renal replacement therapy.

Requirements:
- Current NMC registration as an adult nurse
- At least 2 years' experience in adult intensive care
- Post-registration critical care qualification (or close to completion)
- Practice supervisor / assessor preparation
- ALS desirable

We offer a structured Band 6 development programme, flexible rostering over 24/7 shifts, NHS pension, and access to the trust's wellbeing hub. Full time (37.5 hrs) and part time considered.

title: Tele-ICU Registered Nurse (Remote)
description:
VigilantCare provides virtual intensive care monitoring to 40+ partner hospitals. Our Tele-ICU nurses work alongside remote intensivists to monitor critically ill adults through high-definition cameras, live vital-sign feeds and EHR data, intervening early when patients deteriorate.

What you'll do:
- Monitor a panel of up to 30 ICU patients across multiple sites
- Run proactive rounds with bedside teams and escalate early warning alerts
- Support rapid response and code events by video
- Document in the partner hospital's EHR

What you'll need:
- 3+ years of adult ICU experience
- Active, unrestricted RN license (multistate/compact preferred)
- CCRN preferred
- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, HIPAA-compliant workspace

Location: this is a fully remote position, but you must reside in the United States. We are unable to consider candidates living outside the US.

title: Staff Nurse - Coronary Care Unit (Band 6)
description:
Coronary Care Unit - Band 6 Staff Nurse

Our 14-bed Coronary Care Unit cares for patients with acute coronary syndromes, arrhythmias, heart failure and post-procedure patients from the cardiac catheter labs.

The role

  • Lead shifts and coordinate admissions from the primary PCI service
  • Care for patients on cardiac monitoring, temporary pacing and NIV
  • Supervise Band 5 nurses and students

About you

  • NMC registered nurse (adult)
  • Experience in coronary care, cardiology or an acute care setting
  • ECG interpretation and ALS (or willing to complete)
  • Cardiac nursing course desirable

We work a mix of long days and nights. Internal rotation to cardiac HDU available.

title: Veterinary Critical Care Nurse - ICU
description:
Northway Referrals is a multidisciplinary small animal referral hospital with a 24-hour emergency and critical care service. We are expanding our ICU nursing team.

You will care for critically ill dogs and cats, including ventilated patients, blood transfusions, CRI drug infusions and post-operative patients from orthopaedics, soft tissue and neurology.

Requirements:
- Registered Veterinary Nurse (RVN) on the RCVS register - essential
- At least 2 years' small animal experience, ideally in emergency or referral practice
- VTS (ECC) or a certificate in emergency and critical care nursing desirable

Four on, four off rota including nights. CPD allowance, uniform and pet healthcare discounts.

title: Matron - Critical Care (Band 8a)
description:
Tame Valley NHS Foundation Trust is seeking an inspirational Matron to provide visible senior nursing leadership across adult critical care, the critical care outreach team and the post-anaesthetic care unit.

You will be accountable for the quality of nursing care, safe staffing, budgets of around £9m and the professional development of over 150 staff. Working with the Clinical Director and Divisional Director of Nursing, you will lead service improvement and the unit's response to the national critical care standards (GPICS).

Essential criteria:
- NMC registered nurse with extensive critical care experience
- Substantial experience as a Band 7 Sister/Charge Nurse or Unit Manager
- Master's degree or equivalent leadership qualification
- Track record of managing budgets, workforce planning and complex HR cases

The post includes participation in the senior nurse on-call rota.

title: Band 6 Staff Nurse - General Intensive Care Unit
company: Croal Valley Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
Croal Valley Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust serves a population of more than 300,000 people across Bolton and the surrounding towns. We are proud to have been rated Good by the Care Quality Commission, and our staff survey results for team working and support from line managers are among the best in the North West.

Our values - compassion, openness and pride - are at the heart of everything we do. We have invested heavily in our people over the last three years: a new staff wellbeing centre opened on site in 2025, we offer free onsite parking for night staff, a salary sacrifice car scheme, a cycle-to-work scheme, discounted gym membership, an in-house nursery and a staff restaurant open 24 hours a day.

We support flexible working from day one, including self-rostering on many of our units, term-time contracts and annualised hours. Our Professional Development Team funds accredited modules at local universities and protected study days, and our Band 6 Leadership Programme has supported more than 200 nurses into senior roles.

The unit
Our 20-bed General Intensive Care Unit admits medical, surgical and trauma patients requiring level 2 and level 3 care. We have a dedicated practice education team and a close partnership with the critical care outreach service.

What we are looking for

  • Registered Nurse (Adult) with active NMC registration
  • Minimum 18 months' experience in adult intensive care
  • Post-registration critical care qualification
  • Able to coordinate the unit and support junior staff
  • Practice assessor preparation, or willing to complete

Shift pattern: 11.5 hour days and nights, including weekends.

title: ICU Senior Staff Nurse (Band 6)
company: Greater Ardwick University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
The adult intensive care unit at Medlock Royal Infirmary is recruiting Senior Staff Nurses at Band 6. We are a 32-bed tertiary unit caring for patients after major surgery, with severe respiratory failure, sepsis and multi-organ failure.

You will lead a team of nurses on shift, act as nurse in charge when required, and support the education of staff and students. You will be confident caring for ventilated patients, managing invasive monitoring and running CRRT.

You will need:
- NMC registration (adult field)
- 2+ years' recent ICU experience
- A post-registration critical care course
- ALS, or willingness to complete within 6 months

Full and part time posts available. Rotations to the regional transfer service are possible after 12 months.

title: Staff Nurse - Paediatric Intensive Care Unit (Band 6)
company: Irk Valley Children's Hospital NHS Foundation Trust
description:
PAEDIATRIC INTENSIVE CARE UNIT -- BAND 6 STAFF NURSE

Irk Valley Children's Hospital PICU is one of the largest in the north of England (24 beds), caring for critically ill children from birth to 16 years, including cardiac, neurosurgical and trauma patients.

*** ESSENTIAL ***
  - Registered Nurse - Child (NMC Part 1, children's field). Applicants registered only in the adult field will NOT be shortlisted for this post
  - Minimum 2 yrs paediatric critical care experience
  - Paediatric critical care course (or equivalent)
  - EPALS / APLS

*** DESIRABLE ***
  - Experience of paediatric retrieval / transport
  - Teaching qualification

Mix of days and nights, 37.5 hrs. Contact the PICU Matron for an informal visit.

title: Theatre Recovery Nurse (PACU) - Band 6 equivalent
description:
Hallworth Private Hospital is a 60-bed independent hospital with 6 theatres, offering orthopaedic, general, gynaecological and cosmetic surgery.

We are looking for an experienced Registered Nurse to join our Post-Anaesthetic Care Unit. You will receive patients from theatre, manage airways and post-operative pain, recognise and respond to deterioration, and hand over safely to the ward or our level 2 unit.

About you:
- NMC registered nurse
- Experience in recovery, anaesthetics, ICU or HDU
- ILS (ALS desirable)
- Confident with airway management and PCA/epidurals

Monday to Friday with some Saturday lists and an on-call commitment. 35 days annual leave including bank holidays, private medical cover and a contributory pension.

title: ICU Staff Nurse - Adult Intensive Care
description:
St Brigid's University Hospital is a 600-bed acute teaching hospital in Dublin city centre. Our 22-bed adult ICU is recruiting Staff Nurses on permanent full-time contracts.

This is an on-site role based in Dublin; there is no remote or hybrid option. Successful candidates from outside Ireland will need to relocate and register with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI) before starting. We provide a relocation package of up to €3,000 and four weeks' supernumerary orientation.

Requirements: registered general nurse; at least 1 year of ICU experience; a postgraduate qualification in intensive care nursing is desirable. Salary on the HSE consolidated scale, with a 13-hour shift pattern.

title: Junior Sister - Intensive Therapy Unit
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Junior Sister / Junior Charge Nurse (Agenda for Change Band 6) to join our 16-bed Intensive Therapy Unit at our Stockport site.

The ITU cares for adult level 2 and 3 patients from across medicine and surgery. As Junior Sister you will regularly coordinate the unit, supervise registered nurses and healthcare assistants, and help lead quality improvement projects.

Essential:

  • NMC registered adult nurse
  • Substantial ITU / critical care experience at Band 5 or above
  • Post-registration critical care qualification
  • Experience of practice supervision and assessment

Desirable: ALS, experience of renal replacement therapy, involvement in audit.

Flexible working requests welcomed.

title: Critical Care Nurse Recruitment Consultant
description:
Meridian Clinical Staffing is growing its nursing division and needs a Recruitment Consultant to run our Critical Care and ICU nurse desk.

You will build relationships with NHS trusts and private hospitals across the North West, source and place ICU, HDU and theatre nurses on agency and permanent assignments, and hit weekly activity and monthly billing targets.

What we need:
- 1+ year of recruitment, sales or account management experience
- Strong phone and negotiation skills, comfortable with targets and KPIs
- Healthcare background is a bonus but not required

Benefits: uncapped commission, monthly incentives and a hybrid pattern (3 days in our city-centre office).

title: Respiratory Physiotherapist - Intensive Care
company: Peel Green Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
We are looking for a Band 6 Respiratory Physiotherapist to join our critical care physiotherapy team. You will assess and treat ventilated and spontaneously breathing patients, lead early rehabilitation and weaning programmes, and take part in the respiratory on-call rota.

Essential: BSc Physiotherapy, HCPC registration as a physiotherapist, and rotational Band 5 experience including respiratory care. Experience of tracheostomy management and critical care rehabilitation is desirable.

Membership of the trust's multidisciplinary critical care rehabilitation group and support for a Master's module are available.

title: Emergency Department Resus Nurse - Band 6
description:
Emergency Department - Band 6 Staff Nurse (Resus focus)

ABOUT THE ROLE
 * Lead care in our 6-bay resuscitation area - major trauma, cardiac arrest, sepsis, acute stroke
 * Coordinate majors when required
 * Support triage and streaming at busy times

ABOUT YOU
 * NMC registered nurse (adult)
 * Experience in ED, critical care or acute medicine
 * ALS essential; ATNC/TNCC desirable
 * Emergency nursing module desirable or willing to complete

We run 12-hour shifts over 24/7. A 6-week supernumerary period is offered to nurses joining from other specialities.

title: Senior Staff Nurse - Adult Critical Care
description:
Saddleworth & Oldham Hospitals NHS Trust is recruiting a Senior Staff Nurse (Band 6) for its 18-bed Adult Critical Care Unit.

You will be an experienced critical care nurse who can lead a shift, manage ventilated and haemofiltered patients, and support the development of junior colleagues. You will work closely with the outreach team and contribute to the unit's follow-up clinic and audit programme.

Person specification:
- NMC registered adult nurse
- Recent critical care experience (2 years minimum)
- Critical care post-registration qualification
- Experience as nurse in charge / shift coordinator
- Practice assessor

Full time, 37.5 hours, rotating days and nights.

title: Staff Nurse (RMN) - Psychiatric Intensive Care Unit
description:
Our 12-bed male Psychiatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU) provides short-term intensive treatment for people experiencing acute mental illness who cannot be safely cared for on an open ward.

As a Band 6 Staff Nurse you will lead shifts, carry out risk assessments, coordinate observations, and support the use of least restrictive practice and de-escalation.

Essential: Registered Mental Health Nurse (RMN) on the NMC register; experience in acute inpatient mental health; knowledge of the Mental Health Act 1983. PMVA / RRN training will be provided.

title: Clinical Nurse Advisor - Critical Care Products
description:
We develop haemodynamic monitoring and infusion systems used in intensive care units across Europe. Our Clinical Nurse Advisors deliver training to ICU teams, support product launches and act as the clinical voice in our product team.

Responsibilities: deliver virtual and on-site training; support hospitals during go-live; feed clinical insights to R&D; produce education materials.

Requirements:
- Registered nurse with 4+ years ICU experience
- Excellent English; a second European language is an advantage
- Willingness to travel up to 30% within the EU

Important: this is a remote role for people based in the European Union. Applicants must already hold the right to work in an EU member state. We are not able to sponsor work permits, and UK-based applicants without EU work rights cannot be considered.

title: Senior Staff Nurse - Critical Care Unit (Band 6)
description:
Trafford Critical Care Unit is a 12-bed level 2/3 unit supporting elective surgery, the medical take and a busy orthopaedic service. We are looking for a Band 6 Senior Staff Nurse who is passionate about critical care and developing others.

Key duties include coordinating the unit, caring for critically ill patients, leading the unit's link-nurse roles and supporting newly qualified nurses through the critical care competency framework.

Applicants must be NMC registered adult nurses with at least two years' ICU experience and a post-registration critical care qualification. Experience of shift coordination is essential.

title: Nursing Associate - Respiratory High Care (Band 4)
description:
Our Respiratory High Care Unit (8 beds) supports patients on NIV and high-flow oxygen. We are recruiting a Registered Nursing Associate to work under the direction of registered nurses.

You will deliver fundamental and some complex care, monitor patients on NIV, record observations, escalate deterioration and support patients and families.

Essential: registration with the NMC as a Nursing Associate (Foundation Degree). Experience in respiratory or acute medicine is desirable.

title: Critical Care Staff Nurse (Band 6) - Major Trauma ICU
company: Peel Green Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
Peel Green Teaching Hospitals is home to one of the busiest major trauma centres in England and a regional neurosciences service. Every year we care for thousands of people from across Greater Manchester and beyond, and we are proud of our national reputation for research and innovation.

Our people make this possible. We have a long-standing commitment to staff wellbeing: a dedicated psychology service for critical care staff, Schwartz rounds, a staff wellbeing garden, free hot meals on night shifts, and a menopause and carers' support network. We are an accredited Real Living Wage employer and offer generous annual leave rising to 33 days plus bank holidays.

Education is central to who we are. In partnership with two local universities we fund accredited modules, offer a clinical research fellowship scheme for nurses, and run an in-house critical care leadership course. Our nurses regularly present at regional and national conferences, and last year we launched a nurse-led follow-up clinic for trauma ICU survivors.

About the unit
The Major Trauma ICU is a 24-bed unit admitting patients with polytrauma, traumatic brain injury and burns.

Requirements

  • NMC registered adult nurse
  • At least 2 years' ICU experience
  • Post-registration critical care qualification
  • Able to take charge of a section of the unit

title: NHS 111 Clinical Advisor - Registered Nurse
description:
Northpoint provides NHS 111 and integrated urgent care services. Our Clinical Advisors work from home, assessing patients by phone and video using NHS Pathways, and directing them to the right service.

You will need: NMC registration (any field); at least 2 years' post-registration experience in an acute or urgent care setting; a quiet, private workspace in the UK and a broadband connection. Full NHS Pathways training (6 weeks) is provided.

Shifts cover evenings, nights and weekends, with enhancements for unsocial hours. Applicants must live in the UK.

title: ICU Staff Nurse Trainee - Healthcare Support Worker (Band 3)
company: Greater Ardwick University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
Interested in becoming an ICU nurse? Join our adult intensive care unit as a Healthcare Support Worker (Band 3) and, after 12 months, apply for our funded nursing degree apprenticeship.

You will help registered nurses with personal care, repositioning, observations, restocking and supporting families. No previous healthcare experience is needed; we look for compassion, reliability and a willingness to learn. Care Certificate provided. GCSE English and Maths (grade 4/C) required for the apprenticeship route.

title: Critical Care Nurse - Adult ICU
description:
Dar Al Shifa Medical City is recruiting experienced Critical Care Nurses for its 40-bed adult ICU in Riyadh.

Package: tax-free salary, furnished accommodation, transport to and from the hospital, annual return flight, 42 days' leave and end-of-service gratuity.

Requirements: bachelor's degree in nursing; minimum 3 years' recent ICU experience; BLS and ACLS; eligibility for Saudi Commission for Health Specialties licensing. Position is on-site in Riyadh and requires relocation to Saudi Arabia on a two-year contract.

title: Medical Secretary - Anaesthetics & Intensive Care
company: Croal Valley Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
We are looking for an organised Medical Secretary to provide secretarial and administrative support to the consultant anaesthetists and intensivists.

Duties include typing clinic letters and discharge summaries from digital dictation, managing diaries, handling enquiries from patients and GPs, and maintaining follow-up clinic lists.

Essential: RSA/OCR Level 3 typing or equivalent, AMSPAR or experience as a medical secretary, knowledge of medical terminology. Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours, with the option of one day a week working from home.

title: ICU Nurse - Band 6 (Days & Nights)
description:
ICU NURSE - BAND 6   **permanent**   full time / part time

Douglas Valley ICU (14 beds, level 2 + 3) ... we're growing!!

What you'll be doing:
• nurse in charge on a rota basis
• caring for ventilated pts, CRRT, inotropes, trachys
• teaching + supervising students & HCAs
• link nurse roles (infection control / tissue viability / rehab)

What we need from you:
• NMC reg. Adult nurse
• ICU experience - ideally 2yrs+
• ICU course done (or nearly)
• happy to work days AND nights

Free parking on site, flexi rostering, internal Band 6 development days. Informal visits very welcome - ask for the ICU Sister.

title: Registered Midwife - Obstetric High Dependency Unit (Band 6)
description:
Our Obstetric High Dependency Unit cares for women with severe pre-eclampsia, major obstetric haemorrhage, sepsis and complex medical conditions in pregnancy.

Essential criteria

  • Registered Midwife on the NMC register (nursing registration alone is not sufficient for this post)
  • Experience in delivery suite or maternity high dependency care
  • PROMPT training

The post holder will work rotationally between Obstetric HDU and delivery suite.

title: Clinical Research Nurse - Critical Care Trials
description:
The Northern Clinical Research Facility runs a portfolio of national and international trials in critical care, including sedation, fluid and ventilation studies.

As a Band 6 Clinical Research Nurse you will screen and recruit ICU patients, take consent from patients and consultees, collect trial data, process samples and liaise with sponsors.

You will need NMC registration and acute or critical care experience. Research experience and Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training are desirable; GCP training will be provided for new starters. Monday to Friday 08:00 - 16:00, occasional weekend recruitment.

title: Critical Care Staff Nurse - Band 6
company: Croal Valley Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
Croal Valley Critical Care is looking for Band 6 Staff Nurses to join our General Intensive Care Unit.

You will provide expert care for level 2 and 3 adult patients, coordinate the unit when required and support the education of Band 5 nurses and students. We offer flexible rostering and a dedicated practice education team.

You must be an NMC registered adult nurse with recent ICU experience and a post-registration critical care qualification, and be able to work a 24/7 rota.

title: Head of Nursing - Surgery, Anaesthetics & Critical Care (Band 8c)
company: Peel Green Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
We are seeking an experienced senior nurse leader to become Head of Nursing for the Division of Surgery, Anaesthetics and Critical Care, with professional accountability for more than 900 nursing staff across theatres, surgical wards and critical care.

You will set the divisional nursing strategy, lead on quality and safety governance, represent the division at board-level committees and line manage a team of matrons.

Essential: NMC registration; significant senior leadership experience at Band 8a/8b; Master's degree; proven track record of leading large-scale change and managing multi-million-pound budgets.

title: Clinical Practitioner - Intensive Treatment Unit (ITU)
description:
Ashcombe Manchester Clinic is a private hospital specialising in complex surgery, including cardiothoracic, spinal and major colorectal procedures. Our 8-bed level 3 Intensive Treatment Unit cares for post-operative and medically unwell adults.

We are recruiting a Clinical Practitioner (our title for registered nurses on the unit, equivalent to NHS Band 6).

  • Deliver one-to-one care for ventilated and level 2/3 patients
  • Coordinate the unit on rotation and support new starters
  • Work closely with consultant intensivists and the resident medical officer

You will have: NMC registration (adult), 2+ years' ICU experience, a post-registration critical care qualification and ALS.

Benefits include private medical insurance, 33 days' holiday plus bank holidays and an annual education allowance.

title: Remote Telehealth Triage Nurse
description:
Coral Coast Telehealth delivers after-hours nurse triage for GP clinics and aged care facilities across Australia.

You will assess callers by phone and video, provide self-care advice and escalate to on-call doctors or emergency services.

Requirements: registered nurse with current AHPRA registration; 3+ years' acute, emergency or critical care experience. This role is fully remote, but you must live in Australia and hold Australian working rights. Applications from overseas cannot be considered.

title: Biomedical Scientist - Blood Sciences (Band 5)
description:
Our Blood Sciences laboratory provides a 24/7 service in clinical biochemistry and haematology to two hospitals and local GP practices.

You will process and validate samples, perform quality control and maintain analysers, including urgent work for the emergency department and intensive care.

Essential: IBMS-accredited BSc in Biomedical Science, HCPC registration as a Biomedical Scientist, and willingness to take part in the shift and on-call rota.

title: Critical Care Sister / Charge Nurse (Band 7)
description:
We are looking for a Band 7 Sister / Charge Nurse to join the senior nursing team on our 18-bed Adult Critical Care Unit.

You will hold continuing responsibility for the unit on a shift-by-shift basis, line manage a team of around 20 nurses, lead appraisals and rostering, and drive the unit's quality and safety agenda alongside the Unit Manager.

Essential:

  • NMC registered adult nurse
  • Experience at Band 6 in critical care, including regular coordination of the unit
  • Post-registration critical care qualification
  • Evidence of leadership, audit and service improvement

Desirable: leadership qualification or working towards a Master's.

title: Senior Staff Dental Nurse - Conscious Sedation
description:
Busy private dental practice in central Manchester seeks a Senior Dental Nurse to lead our conscious sedation service and support a team of 6 dental nurses.

Duties: chairside support for IV and inhalation sedation, patient monitoring and recovery, decontamination, stock control and training junior dental nurses.

Requirements: GDC registered Dental Nurse; Certificate in Dental Sedation Nursing; 3+ years in practice. Monday to Friday, no weekends.

title: Critical Care Outreach Nurse - Band 6
description:
The Critical Care Outreach Team provides a 24/7 service supporting ward staff to recognise and manage deteriorating patients, reviewing patients after ICU discharge and responding to cardiac arrest and peri-arrest calls.

We are looking for an experienced critical care nurse to join the team at Band 6.

Requirements
- NMC registered adult nurse
- At least 3 years' ICU experience
- Post-registration critical care qualification
- ALS provider
- Confident teaching ward staff

A 3-month development programme includes supervised assessment, NEWS2 and sepsis training delivery and clinical skills sign-off. Rotation back to the ICU is part of the role.

title: Registered Nurse - Intensive Care
description:
Harbourview Hospital's 30-bed Intensive Care Unit is welcoming experienced ICU nurses from the UK and Ireland.

This is an on-site role in Auckland. You will need to relocate to New Zealand and gain registration with the Nursing Council of New Zealand before starting; we support the registration process and visa application, and contribute to relocation costs.

Requirements: 2+ years' adult ICU experience; postgraduate critical care study desirable. Permanent full-time, 8 and 12-hour shifts.

title: Critical Care Follow-Up Nurse Prescriber (Band 7)
company: Greater Ardwick University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
We are developing our nurse-led Critical Care Follow-Up service and are recruiting a Band 7 Nurse Prescriber.

You will run outpatient clinics for ICU survivors, assess physical and psychological recovery, prescribe and review medicines, and refer on to rehabilitation and psychology services.

Essential:
- NMC registered nurse with significant critical care experience
- V300 Independent / Supplementary Prescriber qualification recorded on the NMC register (we cannot support training for this post)
- Experience of nurse-led clinics

Monday to Friday, with some joint clinics at the community rehabilitation hub.

title: Consultant Nurse - Critical Care (Band 8b)
company: Greater Ardwick University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
This consultant nurse post combines expert clinical practice, strategic leadership, education and research across the adult critical care service.

You will lead the advanced critical care practitioner team, develop nursing research, publish and present nationally, and influence regional critical care network strategy.

Essential: NMC registration; Master's degree in advanced practice and working towards (or holding) a doctorate; independent prescriber; extensive experience at Band 8a level in critical care; a record of research and publication.

title: Senior Staff Nurse - Intensive Care (Band 6 equivalent)
description:
Kersal Park Hospital is part of the Kersal Healthcare Group, an independent healthcare provider with eleven hospitals and fourteen outpatient centres across the north of England. For more than forty years we have delivered personal, consultant-led care to insured, self-pay and NHS-referred patients, and we are proud that 98% of our patients say they would recommend us to friends and family.

Joining Kersal means joining a group that genuinely invests in its colleagues. Our benefits package includes private medical insurance for you and your family, a contributory pension with matched contributions up to 7%, 35 days' holiday including bank holidays (rising with service), life assurance, free parking, subsidised meals and an employee assistance programme available 24/7. We also offer a refer-a-friend bonus, a recognition scheme and an annual colleague awards evening.

Our Kersal Academy funds accredited university modules, clinical skills days and leadership courses, and we support nurses with revalidation through dedicated time and a clinical supervisor. The hospital has recently completed a £14 million redevelopment with two new theatres and an expanded critical care unit.

THE ROLE
Our 10-bed Intensive Care Unit supports complex surgery including cardiothoracic and major spinal procedures. As Senior Staff Nurse you will care for level 2 and 3 patients, coordinate the unit and support junior colleagues.

REQUIREMENTS
- NMC registered adult nurse
- Minimum 2 years' ICU experience in an NHS or independent setting
- Post-registration critical care qualification
- ALS (or willing to complete)

title: Critical Care Practice Educator (Band 6)
company: Croal Valley Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
The Critical Care Practice Education team supports over 150 nurses through induction, the national competency framework and annual updates.

As Band 6 Practice Educator you will deliver simulation and skills sessions, support preceptees in practice, maintain competency records and help run the critical care course placements. Around 30% of your time will be clinical.

Essential: NMC registration; critical care experience; post-registration critical care qualification; practice assessor. A teaching qualification is desirable. Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours.

title: Band 6 Staff Nurse - Adult ICU
description:
Tame Valley Adult ICU (12 beds) is looking for Band 6 Staff Nurses to join a supportive, close-knit team. You will take charge of shifts, provide care for ventilated and multi-organ-failure patients, and act as a practice assessor.

You will need current NMC registration (adult field), at least 2 years' intensive care experience and a post-registration critical care qualification. ALS is desirable. Full and part time, flexible rostering.

title: Utilization Review Nurse - ICU Admissions
description:
Clearpath Health Analytics reviews intensive care admissions for health plans, checking clinical documentation against evidence-based criteria.

Responsibilities: review ICU admissions and continued-stay requests; liaise with medical directors; document determinations accurately and on time.

Requirements: registered nurse with 3+ years of ICU experience; strong written communication; comfortable with remote work tools.

Please note: although the role is fully remote, all employees are W-2 employees of our US entity. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without visa sponsorship, now or in the future.

title: Clinical Coder - Surgical & Intensive Care Specialties
description:
The Clinical Coding team translates diagnoses and procedures from patient records into ICD-10 and OPCS-4 codes, supporting income and national data returns.

You will code inpatient episodes for surgical and intensive care specialties, query documentation with clinicians and meet accuracy and timeliness targets.

Essential: experience as a clinical coder; working towards or holding the National Clinical Coding Qualification (ACC). Hybrid working available after training.

title: Band 6 Staff Nurse - Adult Intensive Care & HDU
company: Greater Ardwick University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
Band 6 Staff Nurse - Adult Intensive Care & HDU, North Manchester site

Our combined 20-bed ICU/HDU cares for adults from medicine, general surgery, urology and the emergency department. We are looking for experienced critical care nurses to lead shifts and help develop the team.

  • Care for level 2 and level 3 patients, including ventilation and CRRT
  • Coordinate the unit and manage admissions and discharges
  • Act as practice assessor and support preceptees

You will need: NMC registration (adult), 2+ years' ICU experience, a post-registration critical care qualification and experience of coordinating.

title: Neonatal Intensive Care Nurse - QIS (Band 6)
description:
Our Level 3 Neonatal Intensive Care Unit is recruiting a Qualified in Speciality (QIS) Band 6 nurse.

Essential: Registered Nurse (Child) or Registered Midwife on the NMC register; Neonatal QIS qualification; at least 2 years' neonatal intensive care experience; NLS. You will care for ventilated and extremely preterm babies, support families and coordinate the nursery.

title: Band 5 Critical Care Staff Nurse
company: Peel Green Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description:
We are recruiting Band 5 Staff Nurses to our 28-bed adult critical care unit. Newly qualified nurses and nurses new to intensive care are welcome; you will complete a 12-month preceptorship and the national critical care competency framework, with funding for the post-registration critical care course after your first year.

Requirements: NMC registered adult nurse (or awaiting PIN); enthusiasm for critical care; willingness to work days and nights.

title: Remote Clinical Nurse Advisor - Critical Care Pathways
description:
Liffey Health Partners supports hospital groups to design and audit critical care pathways. We are hiring a Clinical Nurse Advisor to review pathway data, run virtual workshops with ICU teams and write improvement reports.

Requirements: registered nurse with 4+ years' ICU experience; experience of audit or quality improvement; NMBI registration (or eligibility).

Location: remote, but you must be resident in the Republic of Ireland. Candidates living elsewhere, including Northern Ireland and Great Britain, cannot be considered.
